Intelligence Built In

Three Smart
Operating Modes

Choose how Galaxi Energy manages your power — or let the AI decide for you.

01
🛡 Power Backup

Always-On Protection

Priority is zero interruption. Instant switchover on power cut. Mains supplements when solar isn't available.

  • Instant switchover on power cut
  • Mains charges battery when available
  • Solar supplements automatically
02
💰 Cost Saving

Solar First, Bills Last

Uses solar first, then battery, then EB. Switches to grid only when battery SOC ≤ 20% (configurable).

  • Solar → Battery → EB priority chain
  • Configurable SOC cutoff threshold
  • Maximises free solar hours daily
03
🤖 Galaxi AI Auto

Learns & Adapts Daily

AI analyses your location, power cut frequency, weather forecast, and usage to optimize every day — automatically.

  • Weather-aware charging decisions
  • Power cut frequency learning
  • Zero manual intervention needed

FAQ

Quick Answers

Can I add more battery modules later?
▾
Yes. Battery modules use blind-mate connectors and can be added at any time without any rewiring. Simply stack the new module and the system detects it automatically.
Is it really portable — can I move it room to room?
▾
Yes. Galaxi Energy can be wall-mounted or placed on the floor. You can move the system within your home without complex reinstallation — no dedicated wiring required beyond the standard connection points.
Can it be wall-mounted like a TV?
▾
Yes. The Galaxi Energy UPS is designed to wall-mount cleanly and compactly — much like mounting an LED TV. It saves floor space and looks premium on any wall.
Can it be used standing on the floor?
▾
Yes. The system includes a bottom support bush for stable floor-standing use. No wall mounting required if you prefer floor placement or need to keep it portable.
Is the IoT plan really free for 2 years?
▾
Yes. Every Galaxi Energy system includes 2 years of free premium IoT access — real-time monitoring, smart alerts, and AI optimization from day one. No subscription needed for the first 2 years.
Does it support solar panels?
▾
Yes. Galaxi Energy has a built-in solar hybrid input. The AI automatically decides whether to charge from solar, use it directly, or draw from the grid based on your selected mode.
Is the battery included in the UPS price?
▾
The UPS unit (2kW or 3kW) and LiFePO4 battery modules are sold separately. This lets you choose the exact storage capacity you need and add more modules over time.
